title: Cake\Utility\Time using current time in DATE fields.

milestone.description:

body:
Unlike strings, when we're getting a DATE or DATETIME field from MySQL it becomes a Time object, right?

```
object(Cake\ORM\ResultSet) {

    'query' => object(Cake\ORM\Query) {

        'sql' => 'SELECT Users.id AS `Users__id`, Users.first_name AS `Users__first_name`, Users.last_name AS `Users__last_name`, Users.email AS `Users__email`, Users.password AS `Users__password`, Users.birthday AS `Users__birthday`, Users.role AS `Users__role`, Users.created AS `Users__created`, Users.updated AS `Users__updated` FROM users AS Users LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0',
        'params' => [],
        'defaultTypes' => [
            'password' => '*****',
            'Users.id' => 'integer',
            'id' => 'integer',
            'Users.first_name' => 'string',
            'first_name' => 'string',
            'Users.last_name' => 'string',
            'last_name' => 'string',
            'Users.email' => 'string',
            'email' => 'string',
            'Users.password' => 'string',
            'Users.birthday' => 'date',
            'birthday' => 'date',
            'Users.role' => 'string',
            'role' => 'string',
            'Users.created' => 'datetime',
            'created' => 'datetime',
            'Users.updated' => 'datetime',
            'updated' => 'datetime'
        ],
        'decorators' => (int) 0,
        'executed' => true,
        'hydrate' => true,
        'buffered' => true,
        'formatters' => (int) 0,
        'mapReducers' => (int) 0,
        'contain' => [],
        'extraOptions' => [],
        'repository' => object(App\Model\Table\UsersTable) {

            'table' => 'users',
            'alias' => 'Users',
            'entityClass' => 'App\Model\Entity\User',
            'associations' => [
                (int) 0 => 'comments'
            ],
            'behaviors' => [
                (int) 0 => 'Timestamp'
            ],
            'defaultConnection' => 'default',
            'connectionName' => 'default'

        }

    },
    'items' => [
        (int) 0 => object(App\Model\Entity\User) {

            'new' => false,
            'accessible' => [
                'password' => '*****',
                'first_name' => true,
                'last_name' => true,
                'email' => true,
                'birthday' => true,
                'role' => true,
                'comments' => true
            ],
            'properties' => [
                'password' => '*****',
                'id' => (int) 1,
                'first_name' => 'Henrique',
                'last_name' => 'Asd',
                'email' => 'asd@asd.com',
                'birthday' => object(Cake\Utility\Time) {

                    'time' => '2014-06-06T00:38:18+0000',
                    'timezone' => 'UTC',
                    'fixedNowTime' => false

                },
                'role' => 'admin',
                'created' => object(Cake\Utility\Time) {

                    'time' => '2014-07-31T00:09:58+0000',
                    'timezone' => 'UTC',
                    'fixedNowTime' => false

                },
                'updated' => null
            ],
            'dirty' => [],
            'virtual' => [],
            'errors' => [],
            'repository' => 'Users'

        }
    ]

}
```

`birthday` is a DATE type data. It doesn't have time and CakePHP is using the present time, making the original value change every second, unless we format it to ignore time, we're working with wrong data.
